mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month increase in real GDP growth (GDPC1) above 2.5% signals accelerating economic expansion, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 growth above 2.5% threshold fails to predict positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or if the Rank IC over any 3-year window falls below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below -1.5% signals weakening manufacturing output, which reduces corporate profit margins and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO declines below -1.5% fail to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or if the Rank IC over any 3-year window falls below 0.04.
